reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents a Forsage BUSD activation tutorial that directs viewers to sign in with a wallet, approve a referenced contract, and use a link to enable another level. It also asks viewers to copy a referral URL and connects it to the unclear, unverified claim of being “placed to the bank,” making the tutorial a crypto and recruitment solicitation.

citations.quote: After approving BUSD, the smart contract
Now in X3, your 1st level is activated
We've reached 2nd level of X4
Thanks to this you can get placed to the bank

opening.argument: Judge, the video does not promise that activation will succeed or produce earnings. Its walkthrough states a minimum balance requirement, and the transaction screen says activation is still in progress and awaiting blockchain confirmation. Those are operational conditions and uncertainty, not an assured result. Even the later account view shows a result of $0.0 and 0 BUSD. The speaker’s instructions should therefore be read as showing what a user must check and approve, rather than guaranteeing a payoff.

citations.quote: Balance check should be at least 10 BUSD and 1 BNB

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited contract approval establishes that an authorization step is demonstrated; it does not establish a guaranteed return. The X3 and X4 level references identify the controls being navigated, not a successful payout. And the ambiguous phrase “placed to the bank” is too unclear to override the visible pending-transaction notice and zero-result account view.

citations.quote: After approving BUSD, the smart contract
Thanks to this you can get placed to the bank

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A pending confirmation and a zero-result account are not disclaimers about recruitment risk. The activation screen ties a 10 BUSD payment to a cycle involving partners and a stated potential amount. The tutorial then instructs viewers to copy a referral URL. Those features make the recruitment-and-tier mechanism material even without a guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: After that, in the next layer click on reference link copy your url in default website

opening.argument: Judge, the presentation is structured as an operational tutorial. Its title asks how to activate a slot; the description begins with opening an ID in Trust Wallet and selecting the slot; and the speaker narrates the steps as a demonstration of activating a second level. The visible interface also includes video-training navigation. A viewer can learn where the controls and checks are without the video establishing that the creator received commissions or that the demonstrated account earned anything.

citations.quote: How to activate a slot in Forsage BUSD..?
Open your ID in Trust Wallet and click on the slot you want to activate.
This is how you activate the second level!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening correctly identifies wallet sign-in, contract approval and a referral URL, but those steps can also be the subject of a tutorial. The cited X3/X4 statements describe which levels the speaker selects. The unusual “placed to the bank” line supplies no clear explanation of a commission, rate or realized payment. Calling the demonstration a solicitation requires more than the mere presence of an account workflow.

citations.quote: Now in X3, your 1st level is activated
We've reached 2nd level of X4
Thanks to this you can get placed to the bank

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Tutorial format does not make the instructions neutral. The speaker walks through approving a contract and says approval can be made through a link below, then directs the viewer to copy a referral URL. The activation screen presents partners and a potential amount for a paid level. Together, these are instructions for participating in a tiered referral structure, not merely an explanation of interface controls.

citations.quote: Now for making the connection you need to approve our contract. Approve BUST Activation is on progress. You can make the approval through the link mentioned below.
After that, in the next layer click on reference link copy your url in default website

opening.argument: Judge, an affiliate link and a registration button do not, by themselves, prove a deceptive recruitment scheme. This interface places an affiliate link alongside training and other platform tools, while the later account view displays zero partners and a zero result. The narration tells users to copy a referral URL, but it does not say the displayed account has earned referral income or that copying the URL guarantees it. The observable evidence supports a platform referral feature; it does not establish that the particular account shown received a downline payout.

citations.quote: After that, in the next layer click on reference link copy your url in default website

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution’s opening moves from showing a contract approval and referral URL to calling the video a recruitment solicitation. But an authorization screen does not show where funds ultimately went, and a copied URL does not show that anyone joined through it. Its “placed to the bank” quotation is particularly weak evidence of a concrete earnings promise: the phrase neither specifies a payment nor shows one occurring.

citations.quote: After approving BUSD, the smart contract
Thanks to this you can get placed to the bank

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The issue is not whether this account already received a payout. The video demonstrates paying to activate another X4 level, and that activation screen explicitly connects the amount to a partner cycle and a potential return. The affiliate-link controls and instruction to copy a referral URL show how others are brought into that structure. A zero current result does not erase the mechanism being promoted.
